source.summary: PR 26 remains draft. The previously verified $1.09 website sandbox payment and signed provider event remain recorded once. Recovery patch cfcaba1538c193fdc60e90f1bb9101c2a78c2714 was installed only in isolated commerce.php and generated shop JS/HTML by run 39222078093. Completed unpaid payments now stay locked as processing; matching canonical failed intents with zero received/capturable funds permit a fresh attempt. Failed notifications are signed, canonically retrieved and deduplicated; paid records cannot regress or permit another payment. The actual restricted sandbox key passed expanded PaymentIntent read, original paid audit/replay and exact HTTPS asset/runtime checks passed, and production homepage/private config hashes are unchanged. The test endpoint is canonically subscribed to async_payment_failed. All 248 local/deployment tests and source CI passed; final updater b733874f81257ff14b9e35289893009c5c15224e is manual-only. Actual delayed-method failure and remaining negative-case acceptance, owner product/shipping/pricing/capacity and approved live merchant setup remain pending. Production payments stay off.

product_observations.finding: Customer account/upload backend and draft tier limits are present; paid billing and live hardware playback are not implemented in this documented repository release.
Mirror builder quotes preserve the supplier policy and 20% markup on frame cost; dated supplier snapshots need verification.

Products links to mirrors and stadiums. Mirrors retain size/upload controls, five saved generated concepts and a studio route for new artwork requests. Both builders provide customer-operated email quote links.

Stadium browsing has 92 teams, sport/team filters, optional image cycling and clearly labeled placeholder prices. Dodgers and Fenway have separate stadium-only lead images; all pre-existing source image bytes, team folders and relative gallery entry order were preserved.

Live cart supports adding and removing builds, reload persistence and Customer Portal import of selected mirror/stadium details. Stadium sample prices total correctly: 99.99 + 199.99 = 299.98; removing Mini leaves 199.99. Private quote saving is disabled with server setup required, and billing is off. Temporary test selections and imported drafts were cleared; no product code or images changed.

Existing draft payment simulation passed all nine commerce tests with artificial credentials and an injected provider response. No wallet, real card, real merchant charge or production release occurred. Live account/payment setup remains pending.

AI capture now masks complete browser messages before streaming deltas and preserves whole plaintext PEM spans plus completed JSONL records during partial writes. The original two defects and the independent review finding have regression coverage. No storefront asset, customer record, payment setting or installed PC capture was changed.

Live account configuration is now installed. HTTPS reports configured:true, signup:true, business:true and payments:false. No staff accounts or merchant activation were created; draft shop/commerce source remains undeployed. A fresh actual signup/payment was not performed.

Stripe MCP authorization verified for Mirroried Led sandbox with livemode:false. No webhook endpoints or prior Checkout Sessions were present. Created one clearly labeled USD 1.00 sandbox connection-test Checkout Session, retrieved it as open/unpaid, and tagged it purpose=sandbox_connection_smoke_test, source_pr=26, fulfillment=none. This is a connection smoke test, not storefront or signed-webhook acceptance; no private checkout URL or session capability is published here.

Retrieved the previously created sandbox connection test after customer completion: Checkout status complete, payment_status paid, amount_total 100 USD cents, livemode false, fulfillment none. Found the matching checkout.session.completed event. No endpoint was registered, so this does not prove website webhook delivery or app reconciliation. No live money or product order was created.

Read-only GitHub Actions sandbox credential run 39193263549 reached the secret-backed check and returned restricted_sandbox_key_required. This distinguishes a nonempty invalid saved value from an unavailable secret without exposing its content. No provider API request, website deployment, private hosting change or live activation occurred. Final preflight workflow is manual only.

Reran the existing private sandbox check after the owner reported updating the GitHub secret. Run 39193263549 attempt 2, job 117872461631, again returned restricted_sandbox_key_required. This is the local rk_test_ format gate, not a Stripe authentication/API response. The saved value was not read or disclosed and no provider request or website change occurred. Ask for the non-secret prefix only before requesting more credential replacement.

After the owner replaced the previously live-mode key with a sandbox restricted key, GitHub run 39193263549 attempt 3 succeeded. Its seven safety tests passed and a fixed HTTPS GET to the Stripe Checkout Sessions API returned sandbox-only records. The redacted report confirms checkout_read_verified:true, checkout_write_verified:false, website_configured:false, webhook_verified:false, live_activation:false. No secret/customer/provider payload was exposed and no Stripe write or website deployment occurred.

Installed and verified a separate test storefront at https://mirroriedled.com/MLED_checkout_TEST/shop/ from source f1e869cd00bef0934090a61713982c6eaee504a1. Private config/credential/SQLite storage are isolated outside public_html; browser cart, IndexedDB artwork and stadium drafts are namespaced. Checkout disabled, mode test, no staff, tax/fulfillment confirmations false. Generated public files match private receipt over HTTPS; API source header and sandbox cookie path match; internal PHP is denied; production homepage checksum stayed unchanged. Temporary credential transport cleanup succeeded. Final installer workflow is manual only.

Automatic approval review rejected the attempted sandbox webhook registration because Stripe creation would initially make the endpoint active before a separate disable operation and before the signing secret is installed. No endpoint was created; subsequent sandbox endpoint read still returned zero. Do not retry or use another execution route without resolving this approval boundary.

After explicit owner approval of initial active creation followed by immediate pause, created the isolated website webhook in Mirroried Led sandbox and immediately disabled it. A subsequent canonical endpoint list confirmed exactly one matching URL, status disabled and livemode false. Three events are registered: checkout.session.completed, checkout.session.async_payment_succeeded and checkout.session.expired. The signing secret was returned privately and was not logged or committed; private installation is pending. Website checkout stays disabled and signed delivery remains unverified. No live account configuration changed.

Securely installed the owner-saved endpoint signer from Actions secret into only the isolated sandbox private credentials/config. Run 39197811440 passed 16 isolation tests, secret format gate, private install, actual PHP configured-secret equality check, disabled-payment HTTPS check and temporary transport cleanup. Production homepage and private configuration checksums unchanged; no customer data or public assets modified. Canonical Stripe read still shows disabled/test mode. Independent review interruption finding was reproduced then fixed with a process-scoped lock and abrupt-exit recovery regression. All 208 tests and source CI passed. Final workflow is manual-only. Format and runtime read do not prove endpoint-specific signed delivery or website Checkout writes.

Fresh authenticated reads in the explicitly selected Mirroried Led sandbox returned Tax Settings status pending, missing_fields head_office, livemode false; active Tax Registration list was empty with has_more false. Stripe documentation confirms sandbox tax settings are separate and at least one sandbox registration is needed to test automatic tax. No tax write, invented address, registration, website configuration change or payment activation occurred. Owner head-office address entry in the sandbox is the next prerequisite; test registration and actual quoted-order checkout/signed delivery remain pending.

After owner completed the sandbox Tax setup, canonical settings read returned active, livemode false and head office present. Listed all sandbox registrations and confirmed zero, then created one US/CA state_sales_tax registration. A fresh active-registration list verified exactly one active California test registration with livemode false. No head-office address is recorded here. No live tax registration, production tax change, website source/config change or payment activation occurred. Website Checkout writes and signed webhook acceptance remain pending; next user step is a test customer account in the isolated test shop.

Located the owner-selected sandbox order by one-way reference fingerprint without publishing its raw reference, account, address or artwork. Copied its uploaded artwork privately as a clearly labeled non-production test proof and used existing business proof/offer validations in temporary CLI sales scope. Published $1 product plus test tax/$0 shipping, artificial 1–2 day production/transit estimates, explicit no fabrication/shipping. Customer approval left pending; no permanent staff access or payment enablement. Run 39200193536 verified success, unchanged production homepage/private config hashes, disabled HTTPS payment capability and transport cleanup. Review found interrupted-copy/publication retry defects; reproduced then fixed with verified temporary copy, atomic rename and process-scoped lock. All 219 local tests and source CI passed; 11 helper tests cover interruption, concurrency, scope and preservation. Final workflow manual-only.

Verified the customer-approved artificial proof and current $1 product/$0 shipping offer in the isolated private database. Published only a version-pinned sandbox commerce backend plus private readiness flags, preserving production hashes and private accounts/approval. Stable integration identifier survives provider-timeout retries without changing the idempotent request. Harmless self-signed unknown-event delivery/replay passed and invalid, expired and tampered signatures were rejected; this is not actual Stripe-signed delivery. Enabled only the canonically verified test-mode endpoint after server verification. All 228 local and deployment-job tests passed; independent review found no Critical/Important issue for this artificial card test. Follow-up before broader rollout: handle failed delayed payments and their unlock/retry path. Customer must open and pay actual website sandbox Checkout; provider write permissions and canonical payment/delivery/replay acceptance remain pending. Production payments and fulfillment remain off.

User completed actual website sandbox Checkout. Canonical Stripe reads verified complete/paid, $1.09 total ($1 product, $0 shipping, $0.09 tax), test mode, matching order and succeeded PaymentIntent. The actual completed event appeared under delivery_success:true with zero pending webhooks. Private query-only acceptance verified the approved artificial proof, paid snapshot/reference, actual provider event receipt and exactly one confirmation. Two self-signed duplicates of the already-processed event preserved uniqueness; this was not a Stripe resend. Run 39219632873 passed runtime checks, unchanged production hashes and transport cleanup. All 234 local tests passed, including a forced-OPcache regression. Final manual-only source CI exposed cached mutable test configuration; reproduced exact 503 with forced cache, then fixed only the local HTTP fixture by disabling OPcache. Independent reviews found no Critical/Important issue. No production release, permanent staff assignment or live payment activation occurred. Broader delayed-payment failure handling and actual failure/cancel/expiry acceptance, confirmed real pricing/fulfillment, and approved live setup remain pending. Final source Storefront CI 39220263111 and shared workflow CI 39220263094 passed at the fixture correction.

Reproduced failed delayed payments remaining open, processing-payment retry risk and a later failed row obscuring an existing paid record. Added canonical expanded-intent handling, explicit processing/failed states, conservative zero-received/capturable failure gates, one failure notice, fresh-attempt idempotency, cross-attempt paid/review protection and clearer customer messages. Signed async failure events retrieve canonical state; stale failures cannot downgrade paid records. All 248 tests passed, including 21 commerce and five updater cases; independent reviews found no Critical/Important issue. Guarded updater privately preflighted the actual installed rk_test_ expanded read, atomically backed up and changed only three isolated files, preserved receipt history/config/customer records, reverified the original paid order/replay and exact JS/HTML/runtime source. Production hashes unchanged. Added failed-event subscription only after stage verification and canonically verified test mode. Final updater manual-only. Actual delayed-method failure and remaining negative-case acceptance are not claimed, and no live activation occurred.
